title: Read member's Share Savings available balance
description: Signs on to LedgerLine Core 7.2, searches Member Inquiry by member number, opens the member account summary, and extracts the Available Balance of the Share Savings account. Use when an agent needs a member's Share Savings available balance. Read-only; no changes are posted.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member number to look up in Member Inquiry (e.g. '10234')

outputs.name: share_savings_available_balance
outputs.description: Available balance of the member's Share Savings account (suffix S01)

steps.intent: Enter the operator ID to sign on to LedgerLine Core

target.rationale: textbox identified by its visual-label 'Operator ID' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Fallback: form field name 'opid' (part of the server's form contract, stable across skins).

steps.intent: Enter the operator password to sign on

target.rationale: password identified by its visual-label 'Password' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Fallback: form field name 'pwd' (part of the server's form contract, stable across skins).

steps.intent: Submit the sign-on form to enter the core application

target.rationale: button identified by its content 'Sign On' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids.

steps.intent: Open the Member Inquiry function to search for the member

target.rationale: link identified by its content 'Member Inquiry' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

steps.intent: Enter the member number to look up

target.rationale: textbox identified by its visual-label 'Member No.' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Fallback: form field name 'mid' (part of the server's form contract, stable across skins). Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

steps.intent: Run the member search to display the member's accounts

target.rationale: button identified by its content 'Search' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

steps.intent: Open the member record to view their account list

target.rationale: link identified by its content 'Select' - what an operator sees; legacy page has no ids/test-ids. Scoped to the table row containing the input parameter. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

steps.intent: The goal asks for the available balance of the Share Savings account

target.rationale: Value cell located by its row label 'Share Savings' and column header 'Available Balance'; cell content is data and never used for targeting. Last fallback ignores the frame, tolerating layout (frameset) changes.

provenance.goal: Signed on to LedgerLine Core, ran Member Inquiry for member {{inputs.member_id}}, selected the member record, and read the Share Savings (suffix S01) available balance: $12,425.18 (current balance $12,450.18).
